title: Arthys' Ebonite (AE)
description: A small but useful and unique nether-based material packed with redstone utilities, enchantments, and more.
body:
![IMPORTANT](https://i.imgur.com/VAbg3ja_d.png?maxwidth=520&shape=thumb&fidelity=high)

This mod requires **Arthys' Elemental Engine**, which can be downloaded [here.](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/arthys-elemental-engine-aee-forge)

![General Build Showcase Portal](https://i.imgur.com/JQYFAbF.png)


### What is Arthys' Ebonite?
Arthys' Ebonite is a small but extremely fun and useful material pack that adds a new ore to the nether and provides a diverse range of possibilities from magical tools to custom enchantments to redstone, smithing, and building blocks. It even adds a small non-invasive structure, which can be found in the Basalt Deltas and holds the mod's only non-craftable items.

### How do I play?
You'll start off exploring the nether, looking for ebonite ore, which can be mined and crafted into the many blocks this mod has to offer. However, since the armor and tools have their own impactful traits, they are locked behind an upgrade template, which you can find by exploring Basalt Deltas and looking for a small ruins structure. Once you have the template, combine it with diamond materials on a smithing table. Be sure to use JEI if you don't know a specific recipe, this mod is compatible.

### Where can I learn more and submit my own ideas?
Since the mod is in its early production, I am open to receiving many crowd ideas for future updates as well as bug reports and other feedback. Since this is my own standalone project, it will exist separately from my past servers, and can be found [here.](https://discord.gg/QKZWbAvW56).  Additionally, I will be trying to make a mini information forum there as well, if you have any questions concerning the mod and its playthrough, just let me know.
